source.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10: Setting up an IPsec VPN
source.applicability: Implementation guide for IPsec VPNs on enterprise Linux systems using Libreswan. Covers security parameter configuration, network traffic selectors, and encryption settings relevant to VPN implementation requirements.

passages.text: This method uses X.509 certificates from a trusted Certificate Authority (CA). Each peer proves its identity with its certificate and private key. The other peer verifies the certificate against the trusted CA.
the gateway verifies that client certificates are issued by the same trusted CA and automatically uses a certificate revocation list (CRL) to ensure access is denied for any revoked certificates.
If you use this host in a network with DHCP or Stateless Address Autoconfiguration (SLAAC), the connection can be vulnerable to being redirected.
